## Resistencia de Materiales

Currently taught in the second year of the Bachelor's Degree in Aerospace Engineering and, when applicable, in the Bachelor's Degrees in Electrical Engineering and Industrial Electronics and Automation Engineering.

Topics include stress and strain, axial loading, torsion, bending, shear stresses, deflection and basic structural analysis.

## Mecánica del Sólido Deformable

Second-year subject in the Bachelor's Degree in Aerospace Engineering. The course develops continuum and solid mechanics concepts with analytical, experimental and numerical components.

Current teaching developments include practical use of **Abaqus**, experimental demonstrations and activities that connect theoretical models with measured structural response.

## Educational innovation

Selected projects include:

- **PÍXEL — PÍldoras eXperimentales para la Enseñanza de ingeniería en el auLa** (2025–2027), co-led within a UCLM teaching innovation project.
- **FORMATING — Fortaleciendo las competencias en métodos matemáticos mediante software MATLAB en Ingeniería** (2023–2025), PI.

## Final Degree and Master's Projects

Supervision is mainly connected with four recurring lines:

```{=html}
<div class="card-grid supervision-lines">
  <div class="info-card"><h3>Composite materials</h3><p>Manufacture, multiaxial/shear characterisation, damage, irradiation and advanced CFRP testing.</p></div>
  <div class="info-card"><h3>Numerical mechanics</h3><p>Finite-element analysis, crack initiation/propagation, micromechanics and damage models.</p></div>
  <div class="info-card"><h3>Lightweight structures</h3><p>Sandwich structures, structural optimisation and experimental validation.</p></div>
</div>
```

Selected supervised or co-supervised projects include:

- **Ayman Berrem Khalid (2025):** improvement of the design and manufacture of a device for biaxial testing — one of the co-supervised TFGs subsequently recognised with an award.
- **Alexandru Dragomir Mandea (2025):** interface and matrix cracking detection and measurement algorithm for microscale FE simulations.
- **Claudia Llario Alegre (2024):** device for tension–compression biaxial testing in a uniaxial machine — graded 10/10 and awarded a quality mention.
- **Abraham Sánchez Romero (2023):** processing and mechanical characterisation of lightweight CFRP–Nomex sandwich structures — award-recognised co-supervised TFG.
- **Vicente Arévalo Madrid (2022):** micromechanical modelling of unidirectional fibre-reinforced composites — graded 10/10, quality mention and subsequent recognition.
- Additional projects cover topology optimisation, additive manufacturing, pure-shear testing, image-based crack measurement and structural laboratory design.
